scope: Current data contract/leakage audit,training and HPO/resources,ceiling/uncertainty/error evidence. Existing scientific artifacts retained; documentary joins, targeted illustrative cases and five existing synthetic checks are distinguished from scientific experiments.

uncertainty_and_errors.targeted_criterion: Existing mean absolute individual-seed error, descending; date ascending tie-break

interpretation: IDs, raw support, causal availability and independence are different checks. Legitimate rolling history is not automatically leakage.
Historical P0 receipts and synthetic fixtures do not certify final content checks or all author ports.
The five existing synthetic checks use CPU fixtures and mocks; they neither train real models nor execute adversarial or randomized-label scientific controls.
Fixed bodies make NAS conditional, without proving full minimum family HPO coverage or granting retroactive exceptions to older variants.
Final-phase wall time, full selection time, forward latency, throughput, core FLOPs and process memory have different scopes.
Failure to reject improvement does not establish practical equivalence; eta with propagated uncertainty and TOST/ROPE remain unexecuted.
The empirical ensemble reference and broad gamma interval do not identify optimal predictability or a Bayes noise floor.
Thirty selected existing rows illustrate extremes without changing A2, the original stratified sample, calibrators or predictive scores.
Checklist counts are neither grades nor weighted compliance percentages.
